basic_info.description: Perched atop a 1930s Art Deco masterpiece in Downtown San Francisco is the one of a kind, full-floor penthouse on the 21st floor at The Hamilton. This world-class residence features unobstructed 360-degree views of San Francisco and beyond. A glass-enclosed solarium with an arched glass roof spans the entire length of this quintessential penthouse and is flanked with exterior decks, providing an incredible entertaining space. This grand-scale condominium includes 3 ensuite bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, a library, and formal living and dining rooms spread over 3,545 sqft (per graphic artist). High gloss paint accentuates the extraordinary period details throughout and seamlessly blends the old world charm with the modern upgrades. Adjacent to the formal dining room is the spacious kitchen, equipped with professional appliances including a Thermador induction cooktop. Addl feat include direct elevator entrance into the residence, AC, 2 car parking, and addl storage. The Hamilton features a 24/7 doorperson, grand common lobby, ballroom, and gym. 99 Walk Score, easy access to world-class shopping, restaurants, and theatres. HOA dues incl ALL utilities (heat, AC, internet, water, trash) + parking, storage, door person, management, reserve funding, etc.
